findings.heading: Packages from Github
findings.proposition: The English says the development version of epicontacts can draw transmission trees on a temporal (time-based) x-axis; the Vietnamese says 'truc x tam thoi', which means a temporary or provisional x-axis, not a time axis. The code comment in the chunk immediately below (line 162, identical in both files) states 'for transmission chains with a time x-axis', which the Vietnamese prose contradicts.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader learns the wrong reason to install the development version of epicontacts. They understand the feature as some kind of provisional or placeholder axis rather than as plotting transmission chains against calendar time, so they will not reach for this package when they need a time-scaled transmission tree.
